subject.title: [security] Expired live lease heartbeats bypass configured active-lease caps

question: Should Crabbox fail closed on heartbeat for past-expiry live leases, or allow revival only when the post-heartbeat lease set still passes active-cap admission?
rationale: Both choices are plausible security repairs, but they differ in recovery behavior for operators with expired leases awaiting cleanup, so maintainer intent should set the permanent boundary before implementation.

options.title: Fail closed and count until cleanup
options.body: Reject heartbeats for past-expiry live leases and keep provider-consuming cleanup-pending leases in active-cap accounting until terminal cleanup succeeds.

options.title: Re-admit through active caps
options.body: Allow revival only after rerunning enforceCostLimits against the post-heartbeat inventory under the coordinator state lock.

recommendation.title: Fail closed and count until cleanup
recommendation.body: Reject heartbeats for past-expiry live leases and keep provider-consuming cleanup-pending leases in active-cap accounting until terminal cleanup succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: The central implementation and recent worker/fleet maintenance history point to this owner for the lease-lifecycle boundary choice.
